title: mail-server: Email/copy accepts non-RFC onSuccessUpdateOriginal
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs handle_email_copy accepts onSuccessUpdateOriginal and its doc comment says 'RFC 8621 §4.7 adds onSuccessUpdateOriginal to the standard request'. RFC 8621 §4.7 (rfc8621.txt ~2950) defines Email/copy as the standard RFC 8620 §5.4 /copy with no such argument. Decide: remove the argument (breaking), or document it as a vendor extension and correct the doc comment. Found during JMAP-2svx.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: option (A) remove onSuccessUpdateOriginal from Email/copy (email.rs doc at ~2348, parse ~2571-2578, apply ~2640-2642) and its tests; RFC 8621 §4.7 defines only onSuccessDestroyOriginal and destroyFromIfInState. Wire change, CHANGELOG.
